w;s úfYIThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

IT is hereby published for the public to know that it has been desided under decision No.6.54 of the general meeting held on 09 September 2025, that the all roads and lanes should be owned by the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha, among the road and the lanes considered to be in the possession of the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha, the roads and lanes in respect of which no case has been ﬁ eld by the competend court before the date speciﬁ ed in the said notiﬁ cation and all the road and lanes which were deemed to be in the possession of the Pradeshiya Sabha by virtue of the decision given by the competent court even case ﬁ eld before that day the roads and lanes included in the Schedule published in the Gazette No. 2419/27 dated 17.01.2025 “ the series of orders regarding the preparation of plans and publication of notices showing the list of roads and lanes maintain by the Pradeshiya Sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province as publication by Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province in the Extra Ordinary Gazette No. 2316/20 dated 24th January 2023 to be read with Section 24(1) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No.15 of 1987.

A list of the said roads and lanes are included in the Schedule here to and it is further announced that every road and lane included therein shall be deem to be a road the lane Owned by the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha under the (5) sub section of section 24 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act.
Bൺඇൽඎඅൺඌൾඇൺ Dඎඇඎඐංඅൺ President Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha.09th December 2025, Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha.
